## Validation

Run the checks that apply and record the result below.

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm security`
- [ ] `pnpm validate:demo-fixture` when fixtures, demos, or public examples change
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `git diff --check`

Validation notes:

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No provider credentials, tokens, private endpoint URLs, or personal data were added.
- [ ] Provider changes preserve credential isolation and sanitized diagnostics.
- [ ] Remote-provider behavior clearly identifies when content can leave the device.
- [ ] Security-sensitive findings are directed to the private reporting path rather than a public issue.

## User-facing evidence

- [ ] Documentation was updated for user-visible behavior or configuration.
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording are attached for meaningful UI changes.
- [ ] The public demo fixture remains safe and reproducible when relevant.
